name: Human Creativity in the Age of AI (conference talk)

mentions.name: Human Creativity in the Age of AI (conference talk)
mentions.description: A conference talk titled "Human Creativity in the Age of AI", driven by a custom-built musical and visual contraption featuring a guitar solo generator that recuts phrases of the speaker's own playing into a new solo on the fly.
mentions.source_excerpt: It was titled "Human Creativity in the Age of AI" (which I later learned was an unfortunately generic title, lol), and I built this whole big musical and visual contraption that drove the presentation, including a "guitar solo generator" which recuts phrases of my own playing into a new solo on the fly.
